headline: EMBERWOOD lights up
lede: The Cinder Vale was shipping near-black — the post chain dropped its sRGB encode on the way to the canvas. Fixed in-shader, so every phone reads the dusk the artists meant: town brightness 16 to 65, dungeons still moody by design.

notes.text: Composite pass now encodes sRGB — overworld brightness gates pin it (town 54+ in CI, floor 35).
Portrait phones get a 4:3 canvas: ~25% more Emberwood on an iPhone, HUD clear of the arcade chrome.
Two original beds — VALE ASCENT above ground, ROOT AND EMBER below; the track switches when the light does, and ducks when steel bites.
emberwoodcheck 90 gates; mutation-proven twice (neuter the encode or rename a bed and reds appear).

look.text: SSX: real snow and rock surfaces
